title: Camping by the Pond
lines: Sam, Pam and Mom are camping by the pond.
Pam is fishing. Sam is resting on a log.
Mom is filling a big pot at the pond.
For a long time no fish is jumping.
Then Pam is yelling. "A big fish!"
She is slipping in the wet mud.
Sam is jumping up to grab Pam.
Mom is grabbing Sam, and they are all pulling.
The fish flips into the pot with a splash!
Mom is grinning. "That fish can jump!"
Sam and Pam sit on the log and rest.

questions.ask: What is Sam doing while Pam is fishing?
questions.listenFor: Resting on a log. It is in the second line.
Pam is slipping in the wet mud, so he grabs her.

questions.ask: Have you been to a pond or a lake? What did you see there?
questions.listenFor: Any answer, kept to what they saw. The story has fishing, wet mud and one big jumping fish.
